meta.note: Sprints 1–9 predate version control; their numbering and dates are partly inferred from file dates.

sprints.title: Foundations
sprints.objective: Project skeleton and a reproducible market-data pipeline.
delivered: Feature registry with 8 technical feature generators
limitations: Sprint numbering inferred from file dates

sprints.title: Domain model and strategies
sprints.objective: A strategy interface that only produces target weights.
delivered: Core domain objects (orders, trades, positions, portfolio)
limitations: Sprint numbering inferred from file dates

sprints.title: Backtesting and validation
sprints.objective: Event-driven portfolio simulation with risk rules and out-of-sample validation.

sprints.title: ML utilities
sprints.objective: Shared machine-learning metrics and time-series utilities.
limitations: Sprint numbering inferred from file dates

sprints.title: Machine-learning framework
sprints.objective: Leak-free supervised learning on financial time series.
delivered: 6 model types including XGBoost and LightGBM

sprints.title: Cross-sectional research
sprints.objective: Rank-based signal research and a hypothesis log.
findings: A001/A002 were first recorded as Promising (revised in Sprint 11)

sprints.title: Repository stabilization
sprints.objective: Version control, documentation and an audit of financial correctness, without changing trading logic.
findings: Audit found free leverage, free short selling and missing dividends in the original simulator

sprints.title: Financial correctness
sprints.objective: Realistic portfolio accounting enforced at the execution boundary.
delivered: Accounting invariants checked on every bar
Financing, borrow fees, dividends and splits
One shared financial configuration for every workflow
Legacy records labelled; legacy vs corrected re-run
findings: On the 3-stock universe, the legacy SMA crossover backtest (+303%, 2020–2026) relied on up to 3.8x free leverage; the corrected cash-only backtest returned +174% (historical, exploratory)
A001 and A002 revised from Promising to Inconclusive

sprints.title: Data expansion and statistical validity
sprints.objective: A 106-stock universe and inference that survives overlapping returns and multiple testing.
delivered: Batched, cached ingestion with data-quality checks
Hansen-Hodrick and batch-means inference; Holm and Benjamini-Hochberg
findings: Textbook Newey-West was oversized in simulation (8.5–37% false positives at a nominal 5%)

sprints.title: Low-turnover execution
sprints.objective: Rebalancing schedules, trading controls and an explicit cost model.
delivered: Execution policy: schedules, timing, no-trade bands, minimum trades, turnover budgets
engineering: Fixed a latent long/short flip recursion
findings: Monthly instead of daily rebalancing cut turnover by 72–81% (exploratory)
limitations: Every date in 2010–2025 had been examined before

sprints.title: Adaptive risk and prospective validation
sprints.objective: Optional risk overlays and an append-only record of forward-looking decisions.
engineering: NYSE calendar; fixes to early-close timing, bar finality and concurrent appends
findings: Every overlay roughly halved maximum drawdown and cut CAGR by 5–9 points; none improved the Sharpe ratio meaningfully (exploratory)
limitations: Thresholds illustrative, not fitted; no significance tests

sprints.title: Prospective research operations
sprints.objective: A safe, repeatable monthly workflow for genuine forward-looking records.
delivered: Recording windows from the exchange calendar
findings: A 12-month BACKFILL practice run (not evidence) completed and verified
limitations: Local clock; time evidence only after each push

sprints.title: Data reliability and monitoring
sprints.objective: Detect, quarantine and log market-data problems; protect prospective records.
delivered: Staged, validated, incremental data refresh with a revision log
Immutable data snapshots behind prospective decisions
Read-only health monitoring and ledger diagnosis
engineering: Fixed: a stock whose data stops could be silently dropped from the live data, history included
findings: Yahoo revises open/high/low/volume for days after the close; closing prices were stable
limitations: Snapshots are local; old-bar corrections need a full refresh

sprints.title: Research website
sprints.objective: Publish the research honestly, including negative results.
delivered: This website (static; built from exported datasets that require the owner's approval before publication)
